deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next verify-integrate housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-captured whenever a feature wave legitimately extends the doc surface with load-bearing content.
description: Line counts of verify-integrate doc surfaces. Re-anchored after the GATE setup-robustness wave (F6) legitimately extended docs/spec.md with load-bearing content: the 'Setup robustness — never gate against a stale or wrong tree' bullet in the GATE section (pre-add stale-worktree cleanup best-effort remove+prune; worktree-add returncode check writing an EMPTY gate_results on failure so no false-fail into the park threshold; the per-PR git-fetch returncode check yielding the new 'fetch-failed' GateResult reason so a failed fetch never merges the prior PR's stale FETCH_HEAD), which set spec.md to 290. The floor was RAISED again from 290 to 291 by the additive pre-merge-base anchoring (#392): the GATE now checks each feature's BASE (pre-merge) declared token set rather than the PR's own post-merge copy, so a PR cannot bypass the gate by dropping a token AND its declaration together, documented as one extra line in the doc-survival bullet of the GATE section — an additive fix legitimately documents its new invariant. contract.md is unchanged at 52. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT LARGER than these baselines (a reduced|no-op verdict) and that the load-bearing tokens survived.
